race.comment: MONARCHAL (11) gets the top billing despite finishing down the track at Ipswich. It was better than it reads, beaten just over 3L after coming from well back over 1200m. Stripping fitter third-up, suspect her relishes stretching the extra 200m. PUHARICH (4) appears the main danger after keeping on for sixth here first-up, and he is entitled to be sharper second-up after racing keenly early. MYSTICISE (6) is the most interesting debutant, having had five trials and a solid second at Deagon most recently for Matthew Hoysted. DANCING BY (10) resumes off a Gold Coast Poly trial win and her fifth on heavy ground at this track last campaign gives her a sound each-way base.
